item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find 2024 evidence that Khamenei created independent institutions with real autonomy from his office or the Guardian Council. I also did not find evidence that the Assembly of Experts, parliament, or cabinet had become self-sustaining institutions capable of constraining a future leader. The best evidence is formal continuity under control, not durable institution-building.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran’s 2024 elections","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-02-29","url":"https://theprint.in/world/factbox-key-facts-about-irans-elections-on-friday/1983652/","summary":"Reuters explains that the Assembly of Experts is supposed to choose or dismiss the supreme leader, but all candidates must pass Guardian Council vetting and Rouhani was barred.
